claim: In the matching retail DLL, the two parameterless Player aftermath methods called directly by FormAnimator.UpdateAnimation are closed as one caller-connected seam. Player.CalcDownTime (0x06004F0D) has an exact 422-byte body. It loads Ring.venueSetting, conditionally clears stun time, skips its primary calculation when DownTime or isDisableUpdateDownTime is already nonzero, otherwise computes LastDamage + 65535 - HP, applies exact standing/non-standing threshold branches, converts through division by 256 into SetDownTime, then applies the exact ringKind-2 HP/SP-rate branch, stores isDisableUpdateDownTime=1, applies the raw spSkillFlags mask-2 HP/SP window that can divide DownTime by 8, and finally applies exact is10CountKO and isS1Rule overrides. Player.ApplySuicideDamage (0x06004F0E) has an exact 247-byte branchless body. It combines mHpDamageTbl[GetHealth(HP)/2], mFailureDamageRateTbl[fightStyle], raw factor 256 and CurrentSkill suicideDamage fields; applies negative HP/SP/Neck/Arm/Waist/Leg mutations through already-closed Player helpers; stores LastDamage from the HP scalar, clears KoLastDamage, then clears isStarPeformance and isS1MoveRecieved. FACT-0014 pins target CalcDownTime after raw form flag 32 and host ApplySuicideDamage followed by host CalcDownTime after raw form flag 16.
